title: Lynn NDE 4972
content: I felt tremendously peaceful. Everything was all right with the world and the terrible pain from the auto wreck was fading. Due to severe childhood trauma, I have experienced many 'out of body experiences'. This was different. In the past there was, for lack of better words, a 'thread' that kept me from losing my body. This time I was leaving it behind. My mom divorced my dad when I was three and he was never spoken about. I seldom thought about him. My brother had died eleven years earlier. They both were beside me and said they had been watching me. Then I felt joy and acceptance form many thousands of people. I thought, 'No, I don't deserve to go to this wonderful loving place.' The people looking at me said wordlessly, 'We know you. We are so happy to have you back with us.' I turned and checked in with my body, I saw the code team working. Chest tubes were inserted. I knew each person there. I knew their name, what they were thinking - it was as if I could be everywhere at once. Focusing my attention again on the new world I was entering many were excited to show me the answers about life I had asked so many times. As I saw them, I felt tremendous peace and joy. Everything was as it should be. Suddenly a voice said, 'Stop! It is not her time.' The voice told me I had more to learn. I felt sucked back into my body. I cooperated by inhaling and reentering the painful broken body in the hospital. At that time, nobody wanted to hear stories about what I had experienced, as if they were afraid. Many people who had been at the code avoided me because I knew their names, exactly what they had done, and felt during the code. My doctor told the family to expect brain damage from the severe lack of oxygen. But there was no damage. Since then I have been able to tap into a peace that even when things seem all wrong, it will be okay. Unfortunately, the things I was told so briefly faded quickly as if I had to earn the knowledge. It felt as if I had lived life with my nose against a highway billboard trying to read it; and that experience took me far away enough to clearly understand what it said - but I was not allowed to remember all of it.

arrival.other_being_detail: Joy and acceptance from “many thousands of people” who communicated wordlessly and welcomed her back; deceased father and deceased brother were “beside me”.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Auto wreck; described severe lack of oxygen during resuscitation/code.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard a voice: “Stop! It is not her time.” Reported being shown/teased “answers about life” but could not retain them.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE included observing the hospital code team; then attention shifted back to the “new world” with many people; then a verbal stop/return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Described being able to check in on her body while also engaging with the other realm, “as if I could be everywhere at once.”

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported prior trauma-related OBEs with a “thread” keeping her connected; during this event she felt she was fully leaving the body. Reported knowing code team members’ names and thoughts, leading them to avoid her afterward.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “We know you. We are so happy to have you back with us.” / “Stop! It is not her time.” / “It felt as if I had lived life with my nose against a highway billboard trying to read it… but I was not allowed to remember all of it.”
